name: Ilhan Park-Traore
role: Social engineering and negotiation specialist — face
location: The Underbelly — sub-street tunnels and maintenance corridors, near sub-level access near State and Van Buren
description:
Ilhan Park-Traore is tall and loose-limbed, moving with the deliberate economy of someone who has trained every motion. At 56, there's something unfinished about her face, like a sculpture the artist walked away from — striking rather than beautiful. The chrome is visible — cybernetic arm — right, full replacement from shoulder — stronger than organic,  — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She came up through the Shelf's informal apprentice system, learning the trade from runners who didn't survive long enough to see her surpass them. She works as a face out of The Underbelly, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

she is not the most talented face in GLMZ, but she might be the most stubborn, and in this city that's worth more.

core_fears: Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
core_desires: A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
To find the person who burned them and make it educational
coping_mechanisms: Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
blind_spots: Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
psychology.secret: Ilhan Park-Traore is addicted to combat stims. Functions fine on them, can't function without them. The dependency is invisible to everyone except their street doc.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Shelf street dialect — layered slang, rhythm-heavy, half the meaning is in the cadence.
speech_patterns.cadence: Staccato bursts separated by calculating silences.
verbal_tics: Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
Addresses people by physical traits — 'hey, tall one' or 'listen, chrome-arm'
example_lines: "People want to trust someone. I just make sure that someone is me."
"The hardest lock to pick is between someone's ears."
"I don't lie. I tell a better version of the truth."

story_hooks: Ilhan Park-Traore discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
A corporate black site Ilhan Park-Traore once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know her face
A crew member from Ilhan Park-Traore's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
narrative_function: Ilhan Park-Traore is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Cybernetic arm — right, full replacement from shoulder — stronger than organic, obvious chrome. Synthetic muscle fiber replacement in legs — doubles sprint speed, terrible on stairs
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Taps a specific rhythm on hard surfaces when thinking — Morse code for a word they won't say
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously

physical_description.build: Lean and angular with defined musculature in shoulders and core — the build of someone who maintains strength through precise, economical movement rather than bulk. Legs show subtle unevenness in muscle definition from synthetic fiber augmentation.
physical_description.hair_color: Salt-and-pepper gray, natural with premature silver from stress and circadian disruption
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid, no ornamentation
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, unaugmented but with the flat, focused quality of someone trained to read micro-expressions
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium brown with warm undertones, complexion weathered by decades of nocturnal work
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones, prominent brow ridge, narrow jaw. Minimal grooming — no makeup, skin shows minor scarring around the temples (old neural port testing), a few fine lines around eyes from constant squinting in low light. Slight asymmetry to her face that reads as unforgettable rather than beautiful.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running from right temple to cheekbone, approximately 4cm, from a knife fight in 2198
Burn scarring on the underside of left wrist, old and faded, precise geometric pattern consistent with calibration equipment
No visible tattoos — she operates in circles where skin art is liability, not identity
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right arm is full cybernetic replacement from shoulder joint down — matte-black chrome with visible servo joints at elbow and wrist, synthetic muscle fiber showing through gaps in the plating. The arm moves with inhuman precision and strength. Minimal attempt to make it cosmetic — the chrome is industrial-grade, scarred and nicked from heavy use. Subtle augmentation scars visible at shoulders and hip flexors (synthetic leg fiber installation points), though the legs themselves appear organic at first glance.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight distributed evenly, never favoring one side. Moves with deliberate economy — every gesture means something, nothing is wasted. Slight favoring of the left leg when stationary (synthetic fibers compensate for endurance but introduce micro-delays on stairs and uneven terrain). Right hand rests naturally, chrome catching light in a way that announces its presence without being theatrical.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 practical: matte black tactical cargo pants with reinforced knee panels, worn synthleather boots with ankle actuators for uneven terrain, oversized black long-sleeve shirt in military-grade moisture-wicking fabric. A 15-year-old Yamagata Industries field jacket, charcoal gray, with custom internal modifications and worn silver zippers. No logos or clan colors — anonymity is her brand. Carries equipment in a leather messenger bag (real leather, rare in the GLMZ, inherited from a mentor) worn across her torso for stability. No visible Φ indicators of wealth.

image_prompt: A 56-year-old East African-Korean woman with sharp angular features and salt-pepper hair in a tight braid, standing in dim neon-lit underground tunnels. Full cybernetic right arm in matte black chrome with visible servo joints, industrial and unpolished. Lean athletic build, unaugmented dark eyes with intense focus. Wearing oversized black tactical shirt and worn synthleather, carrying weathered leather messenger bag. Nocturnal and scarred, moving with precise deliberate economy.
